note: Grouping for the consolidated report. A group says WHAT THE CELL TOUCHES — the surface the two shells disagree on — not what the Rust bug is: none of these fixtures has been traced to a line of zshrs, and a group that claimed otherwise would be asserting something no run in this directory measured. Each fixture names its own group; nothing here is inferred from a title.

shell-core-parameters.title: Shell-core parameters, reached through compsys
shell-core-parameters.what: Not completion bugs. They are in this evidence base because the completion system runs on them: an append that loses $@ reprices every description _description renders, and a name the reference shell refuses to create changes what a completion leaves in the parameter table.

line-token-rewrite.title: The word on the line is rewritten during completion
line-token-rewrite.what: zshrs replaces the typed word with what it resolved to, where zsh keeps the word and offers matches. Both cells are `zsh -f` defaults — no compsys, no zstyle — so nothing in the completion system is involved.

multiline-buffer.title: Completing on a continuation line
multiline-buffer.what: Every one of these carries a control that runs the same completion on ONE physical line and AGREES, so the newline is the variable, not the completion. Owned by compsys_parity, the only harness whose buffer may contain a newline.

completer-machinery.title: The completer machinery: specs, tags, compstate, widget context
completer-machinery.what: What _alternative, _values, compset, compadd and $compstate hand back. Mostly hermetic generated completers, so the case carries its own completer source and no host state is in the picture.

description-escapes.title: Escapes in descriptions and formats
description-escapes.what: %-escapes that one shell expands and the other prints literally.

listing-render.title: Drawing the listing, and redrawing around it
listing-render.what: What reaches the terminal once matches exist: the erase-to-end-of-line after each row, the line redrawn under the list, the count in the ask prompt, and what survives a window resize.

menu-navigation.title: Moving through a menu
menu-navigation.what: The completion itself agrees; what diverges is the state after a navigation key. Each cell's control is the same buffer without that key.

zle-editing-crash.title: ZLE editing: a crash, not a difference
zle-editing-crash.what: zshrs panics. There is no zsh-versus-zshrs rendering to compare — the process dies — so the cell asserts the crash.

upstream-defect.title: A defect in the REFERENCE shell
upstream-defect.what: Pinned so a dead shell is not read as a slow one on the next sweep. Says nothing about zshrs, and is not run by default.
